summary.text: Todd Gollihare is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 12 who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Erica Watkins as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Gollihare assumed office on November 23, 2022, succeeding James Leewright, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee and a member of the Senate Public Safety, Tourism and Wildlife, and Senate Veterans and Military Affairs committees.
